create_telegram_channel: create a TelegramChannel instance with a MessageBus and config containing bot_token and allowed_users
start_telegram_polling: start the TelegramChannel to begin long-polling for incoming messages in a dedicated thread
send_telegram_message: send a text message via TelegramChannel with retry logic and threaded reply support
send_telegram_file: send an image or document file via TelegramChannel with size validation and reply threading
handle_telegram_commands: handle Telegram slash commands like /start /new /status /models /memory /help with user authorization
